qualifier: vitamins A, D and K, including vitamin K-dependent gamma-carboxylation
name: Vitamin A, D and K metabolism and response
rationale: All members concern retinoid, calciferol or vitamin K metabolism, signaling or disease, which separates the theme from the retinoid visual cycle, phosphate/bone mineralization and steroid hormone biosynthesis confusables.

qualifier: craniofacial, ear, pharyngeal gland and limb structures
name: Craniofacial, ear, pharyngeal gland and limb morphogenesis
rationale: Members are organogenesis terms for face, palate, inner/middle/outer ear, thymus/thyroid/parathyroid and limbs, unlike confusables centred on cranial nerves, hindbrain/HOX axial patterning or salivary/lacrimal glands.

qualifier: centriole duplication and primary cilium assembly control
name: Centrosome organization and primary cilium assembly regulation
rationale: Members concern centrosome positioning, microtubule nucleation and centriole duplication plus basal body anchoring and cilium assembly/disassembly, which the mitotic spindle confusables lack.

qualifier: potassium channel dampening of action potentials and depolarization
name: Neuronal action potential and membrane potential dampening
rationale: Members regulate resting, presynaptic and action potentials with an inhibitory bias (TRESK, Ca2+-activated K+ channels, negative regulation of depolarization), distinguishing it from cardiac pacemaker, Na+/K+-ATPase and K2P channel confusables.

qualifier: docking, priming and calcium-triggered neurotransmitter release
name: Synaptic vesicle docking, priming and calcium-triggered neurotransmitter release
rationale: Members cover SNARE-dependent vesicle docking, priming and Ca2+-dependent release cycles for multiple transmitters, unlike confusables focused on vesicle recycling/endocytosis or GABA/glutamate secretion control.

qualifier: TP53 stability control and G1/G2 checkpoint arrest
name: p53 stability control and DNA damage checkpoint arrest
rationale: Members concern regulation of TP53 expression, degradation and activity (including p14ARF) and checkpoint arrest after radiation, whereas confusables emphasize p53 apoptotic targets, senescence programs or AKT signaling.

qualifier: cell death signaling and dependence receptor caspase activation
name: p75NTR and dependence receptor neurotrophin death signaling
rationale: Members describe p75NTR processing and its death/survival effectors plus ligand-less dependence receptor apoptosis, distinguishing it from TRK receptor growth and survival signaling and axon regeneration confusables.

qualifier: complement receptor signaling and neutrophil degranulation
name: Complement receptor-driven myeloid inflammation and neutrophil degranulation
rationale: Members are myeloid immune activation and degranulation sets with complement receptor signaling and a monocyte module, which confusables centred on neutrophil cytotoxicity, respiratory burst or formyl peptide responses lack.

qualifier: collagen crosslinking and elastic fiber assembly
name: Collagen biosynthesis, crosslinking and elastic fiber assembly
rationale: All members concern collagen synthesis, fibril organization and crosslinking or elastic fibres, contrasting with matrix degradation, generic ECM modules and basement membrane/integrin confusables.

qualifier: action potential phases, nodal pacemaking and His-Purkinje conduction
name: Cardiac action potential and His-Purkinje conduction
rationale: Members cover cardiac action potential phases, the ion channels shaping them, SA/AV nodal depolarization, gap-junction coupling and His-Purkinje signaling, unlike confusables about calcium handling and contractile force.

qualifier: telomerase assembly via Cajal bodies and telomere chromatin protection
name: Telomerase assembly, Cajal body trafficking and telomere protection
rationale: Members concern telomerase holoenzyme assembly and Cajal body localization plus telomere packaging and ATRX/DAXX suppression of recombination, distinguishing it from C-strand synthesis, ALT recombination and rRNA/snRNA modification confusables.

qualifier: ubiquitin-proteasome degradation and ERAD
name: Misfolded protein quality control via ubiquitin-proteasome and ERAD
rationale: Members address misfolded protein recognition, E3 ligase ubiquitination, N-end rule and ERAD degradation, whereas confusables focus on aggrephagy/chaperone-mediated autophagy or inhibitory deubiquitination.

qualifier: UV-A and blue light responses
name: Light-responsive melanocyte pigmentation and proliferation
rationale: Members link melanocyte proliferation, MITF pigmentation genes and melanin-type secondary metabolite regulation to UV-A and blue light, which melanin biosynthesis, melanosome and broader MITF confusables lack.

qualifier: biosynthesis, uptake and secretion with receptor signaling
name: Serotonin synthesis, reuptake and receptor signaling
rationale: Every member concerns serotonin, and the biosynthesis, transport and secretion terms separate it from muscarinic, adenosine and histamine receptor confusables.

qualifier: L1, DSCAM, sidekick and nectin roles in fasciculation and self-avoidance
name: Neuronal adhesion molecules in fasciculation and dendrite self-avoidance
rationale: Members are neuronal adhesion molecule interactions driving fasciculation, self-avoidance and remodeling, unlike confusables built on netrin, slit-robo, semaphorin and ephrin guidance cues.

qualifier: RUNX1-regulated megakaryocyte and platelet formation
name: Erythroid and megakaryocyte differentiation with RUNX1 control
rationale: Members cover erythroid and megakaryocyte lineage differentiation and RUNX1 regulation, separating it from granulocyte/monocyte progenitor confusables and from an erythrocyte-maturation confusable lacking megakaryocyte terms.

qualifier: serotonin, muscarinic and adenosine receptors controlling cAMP
name: Serotonin, muscarinic and adenosine receptor signaling to cAMP
rationale: Members are serotonin, muscarinic and adenosine receptor pathways with adenylate cyclase inhibition and cAMP degradation, distinguishing it from adrenergic, nicotinic, histamine and tachykinin confusables.

qualifier: monocarboxylates, TCA carboxylates, carnitine and organic ions
name: Solute carrier transport of carboxylates and organic ions
rationale: Members concern SLC-mediated transport of lactate, pyruvate, TCA intermediates, carnitine and organic anions/cations and their transporter diseases, unlike fatty acid, creatine, cationic amino acid or carnitine synthesis confusables.

qualifier: telomerase RNP assembly and Cajal body trafficking
name: Telomerase assembly, Cajal body trafficking and telomere extension
rationale: Members cover telomerase RNA folding, holoenzyme assembly, Cajal body localization and telomere extension, which lifespan, snoRNP, telomere protection and chaperonin confusables lack.

qualifier: nephric duct, ureteric bud and nephron tubule formation
name: Kidney ureteric bud and nephron tubule development
rationale: All members concern intermediate mesoderm, nephric duct, ureteric bud and nephron tubule development, distinguishing it from mammary, prostate, lung and glomerular vasculature/mesangium confusables.

core: Monocyte and dendritic cell surface signature
qualifier: CD1 lipid antigen presentation
name: Monocyte and dendritic cell surface signature with CD1 lipid presentation
rationale: Members are monocyte and resting dendritic cell surface signatures with CD1 lipid antigen presentation, unlike confusables featuring mature myeloid/neutrophil, activated DC/T cell or MHC II/TLR7 modules.

qualifier: refolding, ER folding and inclusion body suppression
name: Chaperone-mediated protein folding, refolding and aggregation prevention
rationale: Members cover de novo and ER protein folding, refolding and suppression of inclusion bodies, distinguishing it from CCT/TriC actin-tubulin folding, heat shock response and aggrephagy confusables.

qualifier: defensins and metal-sequestering proteins at mucosal surfaces
name: Defensins and antimicrobial proteins in mucosal microbial killing
rationale: Members concern defensins, antimicrobial peptides, metal sequestration and direct killing or agglutination of bacteria and fungi at mucosa, unlike confusables about respiratory burst, AMP production control or nematode/chitin responses.

qualifier: collagen, basement membrane, hemidesmosome and integrin anchorage
name: Collagen, basement membrane and integrin-anchored matrix assembly
rationale: Members span collagen synthesis and crosslinking, basement membrane, laminin, hemidesmosome and integrin-matrix interactions, which cornified envelope, endothelial adhesion, myogenesis and generic ECM module confusables lack.

qualifier: Pol I and Pol III elongation, termination and pre-rRNA cleavage
name: Pol I/III transcription elongation, termination and pre-rRNA cleavage
rationale: Members concern RNA polymerase I and III elongation and termination plus pre-rRNA spacer cleavages, while confusables centre on Pol I/III initiation and nucleolar rRNA gene regulation.
